name: 7-Truf
description: 7-Truf (Sieben-Truf): Germanic trick-taking game; seven as permanent or key trump (Truf = trump). Follow suit; trump when unable. Point or trick count to win. Central European.

history.origins: Germanic/Central European trick-taking game; 'Truf' (trump) with the seven as key or permanent trump. Distinct from Indonesian Truf (bid-for-tricks game).
timeline: Modern descriptions treat 7-Truf as a traditional Swiss/Germanic Jass-family trick-taking game with the seven as a permanent trump; detailed historical milestones are not well documented.
